media_dimensions_check.name: media_dimensions_check
media_dimensions_check.value: ("media"."kind" = 'image' AND "media"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 6000 AND "media"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 6000) OR ("media"."kind" <> 'image' AND "media"."width" IS NULL AND "media"."height" IS NULL)

portfolio_translation_snapshot.name: portfolio_translation_snapshot
portfolio_translation_snapshot.value: ("portfolio_translation"."published" IS NULL) = ("portfolio_translation"."published_slug" IS NULL) AND ("portfolio_translation"."published" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("portfolio_translation"."published") = 'object') AND jsonb_typeof("portfolio_translation"."draft") = 'object'

post_translation_slugs.name: post_translation_slugs
post_translation_slugs.value: "post_translation"."draft_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND length("post_translation"."draft_slug") <= 100 AND ("post_translation"."published_slug" IS NULL OR "post_translation"."published_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

post_translation_snapshot.name: post_translation_snapshot
post_translation_snapshot.value: ("post_translation"."published" IS NULL) = ("post_translation"."published_slug" IS NULL) AND ("post_translation"."published" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("post_translation"."published") = 'object') AND jsonb_typeof("post_translation"."draft") = 'object'

redirect_paths_check.name: redirect_paths_check
redirect_paths_check.value: "redirect"."from_path" ~ '^/[^/]' AND "redirect"."to_path" ~ '^/' AND "redirect"."from_path" <> "redirect"."to_path" AND length("redirect"."from_path") <= 300 AND length("redirect"."to_path") <= 300

lead_lengths.name: lead_lengths
lead_lengths.value: length("lead"."name") <= 80 AND length("lead"."email") <= 254 AND length("lead"."message") <= 1000 AND length("lead"."notes") <= 5000
